summary:
This app is designed for wildfire monitoring based MODIS and VIIRS archive. Public users are able to access without knowledge of code based or data analysis
Advanced users may be able to downloade pre-processed data for further analysis.
The dashboard visualizes sets of location, date, data for approaching hostpots and fire vulnerability. Statitical data and diagrams are used to perform fire records and the data hamonization of Modis and Viirs
